seo.title: About Us
seo.description: Learn about Pi Global GCV Alliance — our mission, core values, leadership, and our global vision for trade, innovation, and shared prosperity across Africa, Europe, Asia, and the USA.

hero.title: About Pi Global GCV Alliance
hero.subtitle: Building a fair and inclusive global trade economy across Africa, Europe, Asia, and the USA through Global Consensus Value.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.paragraph1: Pi Global GCV Alliance is dedicated to empowering merchants, service providers, and institutions with the tools and community support needed to trade fairly across a growing global marketplace.
mission.paragraph2: We believe that Global Consensus Value represents a paradigm shift in how trade is priced — a single, transparent, fixed conversion rate that every member can rely on, instead of volatile speculative pricing.
mission.paragraph3: Through education, advocacy, and community building, we're helping to create a more equitable trading future connecting four continents.

items.title: Community First
items.desc: We prioritize the needs and voices of our member community in everything we do.

items.title: Fair Value
items.desc: We advocate for a transparent, fixed conversion rate that protects every trading partner.

items.title: Education
items.desc: We empower members and merchants through comprehensive educational resources and support.

items.title: Global Unity
items.desc: We build bridges across Africa, Europe, Asia, and the USA to create a unified trade network.

gcv.title: What is Global Consensus Value?
gcv.disclaimerStrong: GCV is a community-proposed price target, not an official Pi Network rate.
gcv.disclaimerRest: It is not endorsed by the Pi Core Team or verified on any exchange. Pi's actual open-market trading price is far lower — a matter of cents per coin, not hundreds of thousands of dollars.
gcv.paragraph1Before: Global Consensus Value (GCV) is the Alliance's community-agreed target rate, proposing
gcv.paragraph1After: — a figure derived from the mathematical constant π (3.14159) with the decimal point moved four places to the right. Products and services in the GCV Market are priced in USD and shown converted to Pi at this community target.
gcv.paragraph2: Unlike exchange-traded pricing, GCV is a symbolic, aspirational reference rate set by Alliance-wide agreement among pioneers — not a market valuation. It reflects what participating merchants and members have agreed to honour among themselves, not what Pi trades for on any exchange.
principles: A single, community-agreed target applied consistently across the Market
Transparency in pricing and transaction processes
Protection against market manipulation and unofficial trading
Merchant adoption as proof of real-world utility
One standard, shared across every alliance region
gcv.paragraph3: For members across Africa, Europe, Asia, and the USA, GCV represents a shared aspiration to trade on fair, predictable terms — with one target rate, applied consistently, everywhere in the Alliance.

doris.name: Doris Yin
doris.bio1: Doris Yin serves as Global GCV Executive Community Director and is the founder of the GCV Movement of Africa.
doris.bio2: Her guiding message — "Building a Strong Foundation, A Pillar for a Bright Future" — is the cornerstone of the Alliance's educational and community-building philosophy across every region.

olivier.name: Olivier Ndatimana
olivier.tagline: Global Community Leader • Entrepreneur • International Coordinator
olivier.bio1: Olivier Ndatimana is a Rwandan community leader, entrepreneur, and international coordinator with experience in community development, leadership, communication, business development, and international collaboration.
olivier.founderBio: Founder of the Africa GCV Movement, connecting African initiatives with the broader international movement through community coordination, leadership development, and cooperation.

gcv.title: GCV Movement
gcv.description: As Global GCV Executive Director and Founder of the Africa GCV Movement, Olivier focuses on international community coordination, leadership development, communication, reporting, and cooperation among GCV leaders, ambassadors, and communities across Africa and other regions.
gcv.experience: Involved in the GCV Movement for several years, he has held different leadership and community responsibilities, developing and coordinating activities in Africa and connecting African initiatives with the broader international movement.

pi.title: Pi Network community
pi.description: Olivier participates in community building, communication, and education, connecting Pioneers across different countries. He shares information, encourages collaboration and engagement, and helps Pioneers understand developments and opportunities within the Pi ecosystem.
pi.distinction: These community activities do not imply employment by, or an official leadership position within, the Pi Network Core Team. Such a position would require official confirmation from Pi Network.

business.title: Kigali Hot Market Ltd
business.description: Kigali Hot Market Ltd (KHM-LTD) operates in logistics, import and export, and e-commerce. Its work includes business development and commercial services, connecting customers with suppliers and service providers, and facilitating business opportunities.

approach.title: Leadership approach
approach.description: Olivier emphasizes unity, peaceful cooperation, respect, teamwork, and long-term vision. He believes differences in opinions, backgrounds, or national interests should not prevent people from pursuing common objectives. His approach brings people together, opens communication channels, encourages responsibility, and builds sustainable communities.

vision.title: International vision
vision.description: His vision is to connect Africa with the global community, create opportunities for international cooperation, and support entrepreneurship and community development. He believes sustainable progress comes from collaboration, responsible leadership, technology, entrepreneurship, and strong communities.

regionsSection.title: Four Continents, One Alliance
